commits.message:
fix: migrate sonarr+gatus from onepassword to azurekv, add gatus AKV secret

- sonarr ExternalSecret: onepassword → azurekv
- gatus ExternalSecret: onepassword → azurekv
- Created gatus AKV secret with buddy placeholders
- Added FLUX_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_TOKEN to flux AKV secret
fix: VolSync replicationdestination NFS path (remove double slash)

fix: unbound-dns webhook host format and env var names

- UNBOUND_HOST: changed to tcp://fw01.in.homeops.ca:8953 (webhook uses unbound-control protocol, not HTTPS)
- UNBOUND_CERT_PEM_PATH → UNBOUND_CLIENT_PEM_PATH (matches webhook docs)

fix: NFS v4.2 → v4.1 (Synology blocks v4.2)

Synology DS1821+ explicitly blocks NFS v4.2 connections.
Temporary workaround until migration to Supermicro NAS (which will support v4.2).
This change requires a node reboot to take effect.

Merge pull request #2862 from osnabrugge/renovate/ghcr.io-home-operations-prowlarr-2.x

fix(container): update image ghcr.io/home-operations/prowlarr ( 2.3.5.5318 ➔ 2.3.5.5323 )

fix: migrate github-status-token from onepassword to azurekv store

The github-status ExternalSecret component (used in all namespaces for Flux commit status notifications) was referencing the legacy onepassword ClusterSecretStore. Changed to azurekv. The FLUX_GITHUB_TOKEN already exists in the flux AKV secret.

fix: unbound-dns cert mounting, PiKVM GPIO pulse mode

- unbound-dns: added ExternalSecret for cert data (unbound-dns-certs-secret), mounted as files at /certs/
  Env vars now contain fixed paths instead of pulling paths from secret
  Cert data stored in AKV 'unbound' secret (CA, cert, key)
- infra-pikvm.sh: changed GPIO switch from /gpio/switch to /gpio/pulse (TESmart uses pulse mode)

fix: decouple certificate import/export to unblock envoy-gateway

- Removed dependsOn from certificates-export (cert-manager issues the cert independently)
- Changed certificates-import wait to false (ExternalSecret uses legacy onepassword store, but cert already exists via cert-manager)
- This unblocks: certificates-export → envoy-gateway

fix: critical Flux blockers — VolSync MutatingAdmissionPolicy, azurekv helmrelease ref, unifi-dns naming

- Removed mutatingadmissionpolicy.yaml from VolSync kustomization (K8s v1.35 doesn't have MutatingAdmissionPolicy v1beta1 API)
  This was blocking: VolSync → rook-ceph-cluster → all apps
- Removed helmrelease.yaml reference from azurekv kustomization (file doesn't exist)
- Fixed unbound-dns ks.yaml: renamed unifi-dns → unbound-dns in metadata.name and spec.path

fix: kube-api LB service namespace + certSANs for HA endpoint

- Moved kube-api Service from default to kube-system namespace (endpoints must be in same namespace as pods)
- Added 192.168.69.120 and k8s.in.homeops.ca to apiserver certSANs
- Kubeconfig now uses LB IP (192.168.69.120) for HA access via BGP

Merge branch 'rescue/20260324-232512-talos-bootstrap'

# Conflicts:
#	bootstrap/helmfile.yaml
#	kubernetes/apps/kube-system/csi-driver-nfs/app/helmrelease.yaml
#	scripts/bootstrap-cluster.sh

feat: hardened Talos rebuild automation, infra helpers, BGP fix, cluster bootstrap

- akv-inject.sh: sed→bash literal replacement, local mode (AKV_LOCAL_DIR), secret caching
- talos/mod.just: post-render guardrails, --insecure apply-wait, bootstrap marker, export-secrets
- bootstrap/mod.just: resource render validation
- infra/mod.just + scripts: PiKVM KVM switch/WoL/OCR, PDU power control (SNMP)
- Cilium BGP: peer changed from OPNsense to Brocade Core01 (192.168.42.4)
- machineconfig: removed VLANConfig (bond0.70/99) and WatchdogTimerConfig
- ClusterSecretStore: added tenantId at provider level (ESO v2 requirement)
- resources.yaml.j2: fixed CLUSTER_CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ID → CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ID
- README.md: full rewrite with current stack, network topology, hardware
- REBUILD-RUNBOOK.md: dual-mode secrets, updated troubleshooting, restoration plan
feat: update helm chart versions and kubectl setup for improved compatibility
feat(external-secrets): refactor Azure Key Vault integration and remove OnePassword resources
feat: update image tags and helm chart versions for various applications
rescue: snapshot current state (Talos bootstrap troubleshooting)
feat(kube-system): add core platform components
feat(flux): add flux-system and cluster reconciliation manifests
feat(bootstrap): add helmfile bootstrap structure
feat(talos): add machine config templates and node definitions
chore(repo): refresh tooling, workflows, and renovate config
